title: Chart-normalized ringed morphism on enlarged etale sites
statement: Let $S$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], and work with algebraic spaces over $S$ [def-trf-algebraic-space] in the universes of [def-weil-size-convention], with every site small relative to its sheaves. Use chartwise etale morphisms as in [lem-trf-space-chartwise-etale-permanence]: every representable etale scheme chart remains representable etale after composition. For a space $A$, let $\mathcal C_A$ have objects chartwise etale maps $T\to A$ from algebraic spaces, arrows all maps over $A$, and coverings jointly surjective chartwise etale families [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology]. Write $i_A:A_{\mathrm{et}}\to\mathcal C_A$ for the scheme-object inclusion, regarding schemes as their representable sheaves [def-trf-scheme-algebraic-space]. Let $f:X\to Y$ be any morphism. For $A=X,Y$, choose a sheaf of commutative rings $R_A$ on $\mathcal C_A$ with a specified ring-sheaf isomorphism $i_A^*R_A\simeq\mathcal O_A$, where $\mathcal O_A(U)=\Gamma(U,\mathcal O_U)$ on scheme objects. The fibre-product functor $v_f:\mathcal C_Y\to\mathcal C_X$, $V\mapsto X\times_YV$ [lem-trf-space-fibre-products-etale-covers], preserves finite limits and coverings and is continuous. Precomposition $f_*G(V)=G(X\times_YV)$ is right adjoint to a left exact functor $f^{-1}$; it defines a geometric morphism [def-trf-geometric-morphism] which, transported through the scheme-restriction equivalences, is the small etale morphism of topoi of $f$. There is a unique map of ring sheaves $\alpha_f:R_Y\to f_*R_X$ with the following normalization. For every scheme object $V\to Y$, every surjective representable etale scheme chart $p:U\to X\times_YV$, and $s\in\Gamma(V,\mathcal O_V)$, restriction of $\alpha_f(s)$ to $U$ is the pullback of $s$ along the scheme map $U\to V$. These pulled-back sections agree on $U\times_{X\times_YV}U$, are independent of the chart, commute with every map $V'\to V$, and preserve the ring operations. Under the sheaf adjunction, $\alpha_f$ corresponds to a map of ring objects $f^\sharp:f^{-1}R_Y\to R_X$. This gives the canonical morphism of ringed topoi [def-weil-pbc-ringed-topos-morphism] normalized by scheme pullback of regular functions.

proof.text: Lift each given normalization through the fully faithful canonical ring restriction equivalence. Conjugation by these isomorphisms identifies morphisms between the arbitrary extensions with morphisms between the canonical enlarged structure sheaves. Naturality of the lifted isomorphisms and their restriction equations identify the two chart predicates. Apply [lem-trf-space-canonical-enlarged-structural-map] to obtain existence and uniqueness. Forgetting commutativity is fully faithful, so the unique underlying ring-sheaf map lifts uniquely to a commutative-ring-sheaf map.

Use the terminal and actual sheaf-pullback clauses of [lem-trf-space-enlarged-site-scheme-density] to prove that the fully faithful inclusion of the enlarged site into the sheaf over-category preserves finite limits. Base change followed by that inclusion is naturally isomorphic, by pullback symmetry, to inclusion followed by Over.pullback f.hom. The latter is a right adjoint, so it preserves finite limits. Full faithfulness reflects limits and gives the required finite-limit preservation for enlargedBaseChange f.

Cancellation in [lem-trf-space-chartwise-etale-permanence] makes every arrow in the enlarged target site chartwise etale. For joint surjectivity, take a field section of X times_Y V and project it to V. Lift this projected section through the given covering after a field extension. The pullback square for the base-changed covering arrow produces a section with that lift and with first projection the restricted original section. This proves covering preservation including the empty covering. Continuity is the existing enlargedBaseChange_continuous theorem; alternatively it follows from these finite-limit and covering checks.

Finite-limit preservation makes enlargedBaseChange f representably flat. Construct the inverse image by the sheaf pullback adjunction, namely left Kan extension followed by sheafification. Exact filtered colimits of sets at size u+1 imply finite-limit preservation of the Kan extension; sheaf inclusion and sheafification preserve finite limits as well. Lift the given commutative-ring map sectionwise by [def-pur-cochain-coefficient-universe-transport]. Apply [def-trf-continuous-ringed-topos-construction] with this very lifted map and the constructed set adjunction. Its ringMap is the inverse adjoint transpose, so applying homEquiv recovers exactly chartNormalizedUnderlyingMap. Transport the resulting geometric adjunction through the two enlargedSetEquivalence functors; equivalences preserve limits and their adjunctions compose. The direct functor is literally the functor in the conclusion.

lean.statement: theorem enlarged_chart_ringed_morphism (f : X ⟶ Y) (RX : Sheaf X.enlargedEtaleTopology CommRingCat.{u}) (RY : Sheaf Y.enlargedEtaleTopology CommRingCat.{u}) (eX : (enlargedRestriction X RingCat.{u}).obj (chartNormalizedRing X RX) ≅ X.structureSheaf) (eY : (enlargedRestriction Y RingCat.{u}).obj (chartNormalizedRing Y RY) ≅ Y.structureSheaf) : PreservesFiniteLimits (enlargedBaseChange f) ∧ (∀ (V : Y.EnlargedEtaleSite) (P : Presieve V), P ∈ Y.enlargedEtalePrecoverage V → P.map (enlargedBaseChange f) ∈ X.enlargedEtalePrecoverage ((enlargedBaseChange f).obj V)) ∧ (enlargedBaseChange f).IsContinuous Y.enlargedEtaleTopology X.enlargedEtaleTopology ∧ (∃! α : RY ⟶ (enlargedDirectImage f CommRingCat.{u}).obj RX, IsChartNormalizedRingMap f RX RY eX eY α) ∧ (∀ α : RY ⟶ (enlargedDirectImage f CommRingCat.{u}).obj RX, IsChartNormalizedRingMap f RX RY eX eY α → ∃ (g : RingedToposMorphismOfUniverses (chartNormalizedLiftedRing.{u, w} X RX) (chartNormalizedLiftedRing.{u, w} Y RY)) (hd : g.direct = enlargedDirectImage f (Type (max (u + 1) w))), g.adj.homEquiv _ _ g.ringMap ≫ eqToHom (congrArg (fun F ↦ F.obj ((sheafCompose X.enlargedEtaleTopology (forget RingCat.{max (u + 1) w})).obj (chartNormalizedLiftedRing.{u, w} X RX))) hd) = chartNormalizedUnderlyingMap.{u, w} f α ∧ ∃ h : GeometricMorphism (Sheaf X.etaleTopology (Type (max (u + 1) w))) (Sheaf Y.etaleTopology (Type (max (u + 1) w))), h.direct = (enlargedSetEquivalence X).inverse ⋙ g.direct ⋙ (enlargedSetEquivalence Y).functor)
lean.note: Arbitrary commutative-ring extensions with specified restriction isomorphisms. The chart formula is the equivalent all-scheme-triangle f-map formula of Stacks 03G8. Uses the landed independent-site-universe ringed-topos interface and existing sectionwise coefficient ULift; the original coefficient universe u and the sheaf universe max (u+1) w remain distinct. The structural ring map is tied to its adjoint transpose, and the small-site morphism is its transport through scheme restriction.
